about: The Workbench icons of the Ri-li drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's data/Li-ri-icon-48x48.png. Ri-li-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Ri-li.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Ri-li.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licences; Folder.info for data.
